title: Jellyfish UAP explained as a group of drones

tellings.quote: these drones now, the the jellyfish UAP looks to be a group of drones. The drones are interconnected, you know, Bluetooth or whatever, and they're coordinated.

related.note: Same jellyfish-shaped UAP as Corbell's Iraq video, but this telling explains it as a coordinated group of drones rather than an unexplained UFO.

plain: The jellyfish, an unexplained flying object on video that is said to look like a jellyfish, may really be a group of drones linked to each other "Bluetooth or whatever" and flying together in coordination. The researcher and skeptic Michael Shermer suggests this in a 2026 debate with Michels and names no source. If he is right, the object is ordinary technology and nothing unknown.
